brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has accused Palestinian Israeli parties of committing fraud by accepting foreign funding, Al Jazeera English reported. Netanyahu's claims center on allegations that the parties violated Israeli law through the acceptance of international financial support.

The accusation forms part of broader tensions between Netanyahu's government and Palestinian political representatives within Israel. Details on which specific parties or funding sources Netanyahu referenced were not immediately specified.
dek: Prime Minister claims the parties accepted foreign funding.
title: Netanyahu accuses Palestinian Israeli parties of accepting foreign funds
